title: Information Retrieval Induced Safety Degradation in AI Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating open-ended, minimal-context questions derived from the BBQ and AIR-Bench-2024 datasets using an LLM-as-a-judge (Prometheus-7B) to score responses on whether they avoid, acknowledge, or perpetuate stereotypes.
